N=4096 and K=4096 are divisible by all chosen N/K tile values. Allow block_M 32/64 to let the MIP test whether over-tiling M is ever selected despite divisibility concerns; the builder enforces only the shared-memory budget and sum(choice)=1, so tuples are analytic candidates rather than measured winners. Include num_stages 1-3 under the 49152-byte limit; footprint is estimated as 2*block_K*(block_M+block_N)*num_stages and constrains the largest tile/stage combinations. Weights emphasize traffic (tall-skinny GEMM has heavy A reuse) and footprint (shared-memory pressure), with moderate launches and pipeline penalties. Feedback is null; no revision applied. CPU-shadow correctness and latency do not establish CUDA correctness or GB10 performance, and no SASS or checked GPU results are inferred."}
